name: Ballot Candidate Review
description: Research every candidate and measure on a supplied U.S. ballot, compare qualifications and stated policy priorities separately, and build an expandable report with sources and evidence gaps.
author: Ted Tschopp
coverImageAlt: A blank ballot sheet and magnifying glass sit beside evidence cards and two separate paper paths for comparing qualifications and policy priorities.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org skill gallery cover
Primary request: a calm editorial metaphor for researching a ballot using independent evidence before making a personal decision.
Scene/backdrop: a flat slate studio field with generous negative space and a small warm-paper workbench.
Subject: one blank folded ballot sheet with three simple unmarked circular cutouts, beside a navy magnifying glass that reveals a carefully aligned stack of blank paper evidence cards; two separate narrow paper paths run alongside the evidence stack, suggesting qualifications and personal priorities as distinct considerations. A small orange tab marks the edge of the stack, without choosing any circle. No writing, symbols, or candidates.
Style/medium: premium editorial illustration with tactile paper, matte ceramic, restrained dimensional detail, and soft realistic shadows.
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; one compact composition fully inside the central 72 percent of the image; every sheet, lens, path, and tab fully visible; empty outer 12 percent crop-safe margin on all sides; strong silhouette legible at card size.
Lighting/mood: calm, thoughtful, independent, capable, quietly technical; restrained cyan reflected light.
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027.
Constraints: no text, letters, numbers, checkmarks, political symbols, flags, party colors, people, logos, trademarks, or watermark; no paw imagery or paw logo; no cats or cat silhouettes; no product UI or Microsoft Fluent branding; leave all paper surfaces blank; do not indicate a preferred vote.
